title: The Marching Stones
prompt: range(a, b) counts from a and stops BEFORE b; range(n) on its own counts n times, starting at 0. Predict how far the march goes.

rounds.explain: range(1, 4) stops BEFORE 4 — it gives 1, 2, 3. The end number is a wall you never step on.
range(3) counts 0, 1, 2 — three numbers, so the body runs three times. A for loop repeats once per item.
